name: hop_localize
purpose: Localize which segment failed for one STAN/RRN from its joined hop diaries. Verdicts go to the operator; unclear cases escalate.
state_template: TRANSACTION: <STAN/RRN, channel, amount, timestamps, joined hop diary excerpts for each segment>.

genuine_failure.instructions: Does this reconstructed transaction show a genuine failure or abnormal slow segment, not normal switch behavior?

failed_segment.instructions: Which segment shows the failure for this STAN/RRN?

criteria.channel: Channel side — ATM/POS/FEP before the switch
criteria.switch_seg: Switch segment — Postilion processing or routing
criteria.core: Core banking segment — Finacle host processing
criteria.unclear: Cannot tell from these diaries — escalate to the teams

criteria: Glitch — completed after retry, minimal harm
Broken — funds state inconsistent or dispense mismatch
